source: PyExamine corpus (Shivashankar and Martini, 2025), Zenodo record 14060772; drawn with seed 42, rank 11 (data/selection/candidates_pyexamine.csv)
snippet: whole method __repr__, lines 140 to 150 of the original
trigger: NOC=136 and NOO=25 (NOFF=1): a dict comprehension whose value formats the value and the age.
copied_verbatim: lines 108 to 119: class _ExpiringDict, docstring and class attributes
removed_from_original: the other imports (tornado, traitlets, jupyterhub internals) and the rest of the module (HubAuth, the request handlers): outside the snippet.
the other methods of _ExpiringDict (_check_age, __contains__, __getitem__, get, pop, clear): not used by the snippet nor by the methods kept.
scaffolding: _clock(reading): context manager that replaces time.monotonic while a value is stored and while the repr is taken, so that the ages are fixed (the snippet calls time.monotonic()).
run(entries, now): stores each (key, value) when the clock reads its own time and returns repr(cache) when the clock reads now.
pinned_behavior: typical: for each key, repr of the value cut to 16 characters plus '...', and the age in whole seconds.
edge: an empty cache gives '{}'; the age is rounded to whole seconds.
invalid: a time that is not a number fails when the age is computed (TypeError).
not_pinned_on_purpose: The clock is replaced through the time module: a refactoring that imports monotonic directly (from time import monotonic) would read the real clock and fail the tests.
